title: FrameTrail project bundle
description: A whole library as one JSON document: hypervideos with their annotations and subtitles, the overview map, the resources index, tag definitions and the playback settings. Never contains users.json or anything from the dot-folders of _data/ (.auth/, .collab/ and any other). Media files are referenced by URL or relative path, never embedded.

hypervideosIndex.description: The hypervideos index with the overview map.

hypervideos.description: The hypervideos, keyed by the ids used in hypervideosIndex.

config.description: The playback-relevant part of config.json. Nothing else from config.json travels: accounts, authentication, privacy and upload settings belong to an instance.

customCSS.description: The global CSS (_data/custom.css), which also defines custom themes.
